I think that is a common misconception, that all research chemicals are "dirty". LSD would have been a research chemical when it was first introduced, if that term existed back then. There is an entire world of psychedelic research chemicals outside of the NBOMe series, which are generally not well liked. Al-LAD actually belongs to an exciting new group of lysergamide RCs that have hit the market in the last few years. As you can probably guess by the name, this means they are based closely on the structure of LSD, with minor modifications to open legal loopholes. In the case of Al-LAD, this is an additional allyl group tacked onto the nitrogen at the 6th position of the lysergic acid diethylamine structure. Many people who have both have good things to say about it. The major difference most people claim is that it has slightly less of a "mind fuck", which some people welcome though others feel takes away from the spiritual aspect a bit.

I've tried a couple of RC's:

25i-NBOMe: You have to keep the blotter in your mouth for 30+ minutes, this is very annoying. Uncomfortable bodyload and nausea during onset. This is a powerful psychedelic.

2C-E: Easy to administrate because it usually comes in powder form. Powerful psychedelic but not as dangerous as the NBOMe's. I always puke during onset.

DOC: Very long trip (~20 hours), be prepared for that. Nausea and puking during onset, but it is awesome to have a good trip lasting so long.

5-MeO-MiPT: Party psychedelic, very empathogenic and not very hallucinogenic, weird bodyload.

MXE: Dissociative, similar to but longer lasting than Ketamine. I like it a lot, but I only do it by myself at night.
